stories.title: Surging Treasury Yields Create a Tax-Loss Opportunity for Bond Investors
stories.summary: Treasury yields have surged this year, and that has driven big losses in many bond holdings, CNBC reports. Those losses give investors a chance to harvest tax savings. An investor can sell a losing bond position and use the loss to offset gains elsewhere.
stories.whyItMatters: Bond investors can turn a rough year for fixed income into a real tax benefit before year-end.
whatToWatch: The year-end deadline for tax-loss harvesting trades.
Further moves in Treasury yields through the fourth quarter.
questions: How large are typical bond losses this year?
Which bond funds show the deepest losses?

stories.title: Market Breadth Narrows to Its Thinnest Since the Dot-Com Peak
stories.summary: A shrinking group of stocks now drives most of the market's gains, MarketWatch reports. Breadth has narrowed to its lowest point since the dot-com peak. Index-level gains increasingly depend on a small set of large stocks.
stories.whyItMatters: Narrow breadth raises risk for the whole market: if the leading stocks stumble, the index could follow.
whatToWatch: Breadth indicators alongside headline index levels.
Performance of the largest stocks driving the market.
questions: Which stocks account for most of the market's gains right now?
How did breadth behave after the dot-com peak?

sources.title: Fewer stocks are carrying the market than at any time since the dot-com peak

stories.title: Trump-Xi Summit Puts AI Safety on the Agenda, but Neither Side Wants to Slow Down
stories.summary: President Trump and China's Xi Jinping are set to meet, with AI safety among the topics on the table, CNBC reports. Both sides want to keep advancing AI development despite the safety talks. Investing.com reports Trump is planning a large public event for the meeting, and the talks could turn tense.
stories.whyItMatters: The summit's outcome could shape US-China tech competition, which moves chip and AI-linked stocks.
whatToWatch: Any joint statement on AI safety from the summit.
Market reaction in chipmakers and AI-linked stocks.
questions: Will the summit produce a binding agreement on AI?
How will China respond to any new US trade measures on tech?

stories.title: Market Now Expects a Fed Rate Hike in October After Barr Comments, Hot Inflation Data
stories.summary: Traders now price in an October interest rate hike from the Federal Reserve, CNBC reports. The shift followed comments from Fed official Barr and a hotter-than-expected inflation reading. This marks a change from earlier market expectations.
stories.whyItMatters: A rate hike would raise borrowing costs across the economy and could pressure both stocks and bonds.
whatToWatch: The Fed's October meeting decision.
Any further inflation data released before then.
questions: What exactly did Barr say to shift market expectations?
Which inflation measure came in hot, and by how much?

stories.summary: MarketWatch reviewed historical market data to test the idea that political gridlock helps stocks. The piece looks at how markets performed during past periods of divided government in Washington.
stories.whyItMatters: Investors often treat the balance of power in Congress as a market signal, so the historical record informs expectations.
whatToWatch: Upcoming elections and any shift in control of Congress.

stories.summary: CNBC examines the economic effects of the sharp rise in Treasury yields now underway. Higher yields raise borrowing costs for consumers and businesses, from mortgages to corporate debt.
stories.whyItMatters: Rising yields touch nearly every part of the economy, from home buyers to companies that need to borrow.
whatToWatch: Mortgage rate moves in coming weeks.
Corporate borrowing costs and any Fed response.

stories.title: Higher Interest Rates Hit Younger and Lower-Income Households Hardest
stories.summary: Higher interest rates squeeze younger and lower-income households more than other groups, CNBC reports. An expert calls a rate hike "a blunt tool" that does not target specific groups.
stories.whyItMatters: The uneven impact of rate hikes shapes the debate over Fed policy and its effect on everyday consumers.
whatToWatch: Consumer credit and delinquency data in coming months.
